rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The Notification of 22 September 2022, signed by Madhusudan Mistry as Returning Officer, announces under Article XVIII of the party constitution that the election of the President of Indian National Congress will be held on a schedule of nominations 24-30 September, scrutiny 1 October, withdrawal and final list of candidates 8 October, a poll if necessary on 17 October at all PCC headquarters and counting and declaration of results on 19 October 2022, and calls upon the delegates to elect the President.
